usedFor: Booqable holds rental orders and payments, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer after “Reserved Order” through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Reserved Order” in Booqable, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A reserved order starts a command on your own computer the moment the rental is held.

watchOut: “Updated Order” fires on every edit, so the same order can run “Trigger Command” more than once.
